liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Let It Grow** (2 reviews): The Eyes and jam in Let it Grow are schorchers; Let It Grow gets real crazy [5][9]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Horns do not lend themselves well to the tune Truckin' [15]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Eyes of the World is probably my favorite version ever recorded [7]
- **Weather Report Suite Prelude** (1 review): The flute in WRS Prelude is very delicate and sweet [5]

## Setlist highlights

- **Let Me Sing Your Blues Away**: rare: 8 archived performances [17]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Weather Report Suite Part One [17]

## The recordings

- **gd73-09-15.aud-sbd.cotsman.16174.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 26 songs; 191 min; rated 4.18/5 by 17 [1]. Said about its sound: Sound is nice and crisp, though Phil is a little light; Sound is a little rough due to the audience composite; First set has poor sound quality; second set sound quality is great [5][6][10][13]
- **gd1973-09-15.sbd-set2.levy.01077.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 13 songs; 98 min; rated 4.55/5 by 11 [4]. Said about its sound: Sound is great like most 73 soundboards [14]
- **gd1973-09-15.171321.aud.lamarre.vernon.andrewF.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 180 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1973-09-15.171320.aud.lamarre.vernon.andrewF.flac1648**: audience recording; 23 songs; 180 min [3]

## Around the show

- The Dead are accompanied by horns, specifically Martin Fierro and Joe Ellis [10]
- Keith is singing lead vocals on Let Me Sing Your Blues Away [13]
- Martin Fierro is playing with them, though the reviewer is not sure [14]
- Jerry, Merl, John Kahn, and Martin played together, leading to the horns joining [16]
- Ellis was added as a second horn to deepen the sound from previous nights [16]
- Martin Fierro plays saxophone and flute; Joe Ellis plays trumpet [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-09-15.aud-sbd.cotsman.16174.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard and Audience Composite [1]. Also: Set 1 is AUD to SHN; Set 2 is SBD to SHN, edited by JCotsman [1]
- **gd1973-09-15.sbd-set2.levy.01077.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD:Master Reel>DAT [4]
- **gd1973-09-15.171321.aud.lamarre.vernon.andrewF.flac2496**: taped by Unknown. Tape provided by John Lebrun to Doug Lamarre; transferred by Transfer by: Matt Vernon  Mastering by: Andrew F; source: Analog Audience Source: Unknown mic/deck/generation Medium Stock Brands: Maxell UDXL-I C90 (120 uS EQ) Dolby On [2]
- **gd1973-09-15.171320.aud.lamarre.vernon.andrewF.flac1648**: taped by Unknown. Tape provided by John Lebrun to Doug Lamarre; transferred by Transfer by: Matt Vernon  Mastering by: Andrew F; source: Analog Audience Source: Unknown mic/deck/generation Medium Stock Brands: Maxell UDXL-I C90 (120 uS EQ) Dolby On [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by rirocks.net: [Grateful Dead 1973 09.14](https://rirocks.net/Band%20Articles/Grateful%20Dead%201973%2009.14%20-%20Prov.%20Civic%20Center.htm) [18]
